description: Election Commission - Notify the name of M. A. C. Munasinghe as a member of the Hambanthota Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Hambanthota Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by a recognized political party, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
